payload.posture: Read 2 Maccabees 10:1–9 as evidence about the Temple, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states maccabaeus’s company cleanses, rebuilds, relights, sacrifices, and keeps an eight-day dedication. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Temple.
